info.title: tencent-video-upscale API
info.description: Enhance video quality with Tencent Video Upscale and upscale to 720p, 1080p, 2K, or 4K

post.description:
- Tencent Video Upscale (tencent-video-upscale) enhances existing videos and upscales them to `720p`, `1080p`, `2k`, or `4k`
- Offers 7 enhancement styles for live-action footage, animation, small faces in distant shots, facial fidelity, stronger detail, and softer results
- Preserves the source frame rate by default (`model_params.max_fps: "source"`); use `"30"`, `"60"`, or `"120"` to set a cap. Only reduces frame rate; does not interpolate frames
- Billed by video duration. See [EvoLink model pricing](https://evolink.ai/models) for prices at different resolutions and output frame rates
- Asynchronous processing: use the returned task ID to [query task status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Tasks cannot be canceled after submission
- Enhanced video URLs are valid for 24 hours. Save your video promptly

video_urls.description:
Input video URL list

**Notes:**
- Only `1` video is supported per request (if more are provided, only the first is used)
- The video URL must be directly accessible by the server (public or presigned URL)
- Supported formats: `.mp4`, `.mov`
- Maximum duration: `60` seconds
- Maximum source resolution: 4K (short side no greater than `2160` pixels)
- On submission, the server reads the video duration, resolution, and frame rate. A read failure returns `video_probe_failed`

mode.description:
Enhancement style. Choose based on the video content

**Options:**
- `realistic` - General realistic: live-action footage and other typical scenes — **default**
- `realistic_distant` - Realistic, distant shots: optimized for small faces in distant footage
- `animation` - General animation: animation, anime, and cartoons
- `animation_distant` - Animation, distant shots: optimized for small faces in animated scenes with distant characters
- `face_fidelity` - Facial fidelity: preserves the original facial features as much as possible
- `detail_boost` - Detail enhancement: makes textures and edges more pronounced
- `soft` - Soft: lighter sharpening for a more natural look

Case-insensitive. Invalid values are rejected

quality.description:
Target resolution, measured by the video's short side

**Options:**
- `720p` - Short side of `720` pixels
- `1080p` - Short side of `1080` pixels — **default**
- `2k` - Short side of `1440` pixels
- `4k` - Short side of `2160` pixels

**Notes:**
- The target resolution cannot be lower than the source. For example, a `1080p` source can use `1080p`, `2k`, or `4k`; `720p` is rejected
- Choosing the lowest tier that is at least as high as the source keeps the image size largely unchanged

max_fps.description:
Maximum output frame rate. Defaults to `"source"`, preserving the source frame rate; omitting this parameter is equivalent to `"source"`

**Options:**
- `"source"` - Preserve the source frame rate — **default**
- `"30"` - Output frame rate no greater than 30 fps
- `"60"` - Output frame rate no greater than 60 fps
- `"120"` - Output frame rate no greater than 120 fps

**Behavior:**
- Preserves the source frame rate if it does not exceed the cap; **does not interpolate frames**. Higher frame rates are reduced to the cap
- With `"source"` or when omitted, source frame rates above `120` fps are still reduced to `120` fps

**Accepted types:**
- Strings are recommended. Integers `30`, `60`, and `120` are also accepted (for example, `"60"` and `60` are equivalent)
- `"source"` is case-insensitive
- Other values (such as `45`, `60.5`, or `"auto"`) are rejected
- This model does not accept the top-level `fps` parameter

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL for task completion

**Callback Timing:**
- Triggered when task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation

**Security Restrictions:**
- HTTPS protocol only
- Internal IP addresses are prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback Mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Maximum `3` retries after failure (at `1`/`2`/`4` seconds after failure)
- Callback response format is consistent with task query API
- 2xx status code is considered successful, other codes trigger retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be canceled (tasks for this model cannot be canceled after submission)

estimated_time.description: Estimated completion time in seconds. Actual time depends on the queue; 4K, high frame rates, and long videos take significantly longer

billing_rule.description: Billing rule. This model uses `per_second` billing based on video duration. See [EvoLink model pricing](https://evolink.ai/models) for actual prices

credits_reserved.description: Estimated credit usage (preauthorization). Final usage is settled after task completion; refer to your bill for the final amount
